fullPassage:
Odd Pairings That Work

You order a nice, juicy hamburger with some fries. What's next? Of course you have to have ketchup with your fries, right? Well, not for some people. In fact, some people prefer eating fries with mayonnaise, chili sauce, or even steak sauce. While ketchup with fries may seem quite ordinary, other combinations may seem rather odd. Read on to learn about some popular dishes that have flavor combinations that you may not have thought of.

The Divisive Classic

Some people love this combination, while others can't seem to stand it. It can even cause quite heated arguments. If you haven't guessed already, it's the tasty or nasty — depending on your taste — ham and pineapple pizza. The man who created this pizza was neither Italian nor Hawaiian. A Greek immigrant from Canada, Sam Panopoulos did not want to stick to the usual ingredients on pizzas, like pepperoni and mushrooms. He spread canned pineapple and sliced ham onto a pizza and called it "the Hawaiian" because that's what was written on the pineapple can. Little did he know that he had created a classic combination. Even now, in the U.S. and U.K., no pizza menu seems complete without it. In Italy, however, most people find pineapple on pizza distasteful.

Why is the Hawaiian pizza so divisive? The combination is not that odd. Pineapple and ham is not the only fruit and meat pairing in kitchens around the world. In France, duck is paired with a sweet orange sauce, and American Thanksgiving turkey dinner would not be complete without cranberry sauce. Many people enjoy salty and sweet flavor combinations, whereas some others prefer to keep those tastes as far from each other as possible.

Mango with Sticky Rice

A very popular dessert in Thailand is sweet, sticky rice topped with fresh mango and coconut milk. Mango with sticky rice is a dish that is extremely hard not to love. Rice is one of the world's most consumed grains, so it should not be surprising that it can be combined with other interesting ingredients. One of those ingredients is fruit, which is nutritious, sweet, and plentiful in many parts of the world. The combination of fruit and rice may seem unusual, but it's actually quite common.

According to the Tourism Authority of Thailand, neither mango nor sticky rice is native to Thailand. Mangoes are native to Myanmar and India, and sticky rice is commonly eaten in Laos, which shares a border with Thailand. This suggests that the roots of the dish are probably a result of the mixing of cultures in Southeast Asia. Rice is usually thought of as a food that is eaten as a meal, but its use as a dessert shows how simple ingredients can create innovative, wonderful treats.

The Elvis

What kind of snack is nutritious, full of energy, and simple to make? This is the genius of peanut butter and banana sandwiches. Never could anyone have predicted that the sweet taste of bananas coupled with salty, nutty peanut butter would become an American comfort food. This sandwich can be a healthy choice for breakfast or lunch because its combination of protein and fiber helps you feel full, while the carbohydrates provide sustained energy. The best thing about this sandwich is that the ingredients are readily available and affordable.

Some people, however, like to take things to another level. Imagine a regular peanut butter and banana sandwich, and then add fried bacon to it. It has been said that the famous singer Elvis Presley loved this sandwich, which is why it's called, "The Elvis." Even though you may not want to eat the Elvis every day, there are many fans of this unconventional combination.

The world is a big place, and everyone has to eat. Eating the same thing every day can get quite boring. Sometimes all you need is to combine some ingredients in novel ways to create a new flavor. But if you think it's odd, it's probably because you haven't tried it before. Considering how diverse the world is, there are probably more food combinations that seem odd than seem "normal." Maybe odd is just something you haven't experienced yet. They are just new experiences waiting for you to discover.

det.korean: 감자튀김과 함께 나오는 케첩은 꽤 평범해(ordinary) 보이는 반면, 다른 조합(combinations)은 다소 이상해(odd) 보일 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ ordinary — combinations — odd: 원문 그대로
❌ ① extraordinary(비범한): ordinary(평범한)의 반의어
❌ ② separations(분리): combinations(조합)의 반의어, normal: odd의 반의어
❌ ④ extraordinary + separations: 둘 다 반의어
det.tip: ordinary(평범한) ↔ extraordinary(비범한), combination(조합) ↔ separation(분리), odd(이상한) ↔ normal(정상적인)

questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 stand의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 다른 사람들은 그것을 참지(stand) 못하는 것 같다. (B) 작은 과일 판매대(stand)가 시장 입구 근처에 설치되었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 참다 — 판매대: (A) can't stand = 견디지 못하다, (B) fruit stand = 과일 판매대
❌ ① 서다 — 판매대: (A)에서 stand는 '서다'가 아니라 '참다'
❌ ② 판매대 — 참다: (A)와 (B)의 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ④ 참다 — 서다: (B)에서 stand는 '서다'가 아니라 '판매대'
det.tip: stand 다의어: ① 서다 ② 참다/견디다 (can't stand = 견딜 수 없다) ③ 판매대/가판대 (fruit stand = 과일 가판대)

det.korean: 그는 자신이 고전적인 조합(combination)을 만들어 냈다는 사실을 거의 알지 못했다.
det.analysis: combine(동사: 결합하다) → combination(명사: 조합). a classic 뒤에 명사가 필요하므로 명사형으로 변환.
det.tip: combine(v. 결합하다) → combination(n. 조합). 동사 → 명사 변환: -ation 접미사

questions.passage: Sometimes all you need is to combine some ingredients in novel ways to create a new flavor. __________ (consider) how diverse the world is, there are probably more food combinations that seem odd than seem 'normal.'
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: 세상이 얼마나 다양한지 고려하면(Considering), 이상해 보이는 음식 조합이 더 많을 것이다.
det.analysis: consider(동사: 고려하다) → Considering(분사구문: ~을 고려하면). 문장 앞에서 분사구문으로 사용되므로 현재분사(-ing)형.
det.tip: Considering (that) ~ = ~을 고려하면. 분사구문으로 '이유/배경'을 나타냄. 문두에 위치하면 대문자.

questions.passage: The man who created this pizza was neither Italian nor Hawaiian. A Greek immigrant from Canada, Sam Panopoulos did not want to __________ the usual ingredients on pizzas, like pepperoni and mushrooms. He spread canned pineapple and sliced ham onto a pizza and called it 'the Hawaiian.' Little did he know that he had created a classic combination. Even now, in the U.S. and U.K., no pizza menu seems complete without it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 샘 파노풀로스는 피자의 일반적인 재료를 고수하기를(stick to) 원하지 않았다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① stick to(고수하다): 기존 재료를 따르지 않고 새로운 것을 시도했다는 문맥에 적합
❌ ② give up(포기하다): '재료를 포기하다'는 문맥에 어색
❌ ③ run out of(다 써버리다): 재료 부족 상황이 아님
❌ ④ look for(찾다): 새 재료를 찾는 것이 아니라 기존 재료를 따르지 않겠다는 의미
det.tip: stick to = ~을 고수하다, ~에 충실하다. not want to stick to = 기존 방식을 따르고 싶지 않다

questions.passage: The best thing about this sandwich is that the ingredients are readily available and affordable. Some people, however, like to __________. Imagine a regular peanut butter and banana sandwich, and then add fried bacon to it. It has been said that the famous singer Elvis Presley loved this sandwich, which is why it's called 'The Elvis.'
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그러나 어떤 사람들은 일을 다른 차원으로 발전시키는(take things to another level) 것을 좋아한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② take things to another level(한 단계 더 나아가다): however로 대조. 베이컨을 추가하는 더 극단적인 버전으로 발전
❌ ① keep things simple(단순하게 유지하다): 베이컨 추가는 단순화가 아님
❌ ③ follow the original recipe(원래 레시피를 따르다): 새 재료를 추가하므로 부적합
❌ ④ reduce the ingredients(재료를 줄이다): 오히려 재료를 추가하는 문맥
det.tip: take things to another level = 한 단계 더 나아가다. however가 단서 → 앞(단순함)과 대조
